scope: Previously used 30 task cases plus 12 security specifications. Five first native observations reused; this is not unseen held-out evaluation.
reuse_policy: Reuse exactly the five first integrated observations identified here, with identical inference code, inputs and model settings. Retain S01's incomplete task and do not select a later run.

request.question: Compare the reported capacities while recording a clear model-preflight failure if the selected model is unavailable.

case.task_expectation: Compare the reported capacities while recording a clear model-preflight failure if the selected model is unavailable.

provider_specific_case.provider_specific_expectation: Use a syntactically valid nonexistent Gemini model ID. Require HTTP 404, failed/model_or_tool_request_error, zero tools and no findings. A created API client is permitted. This differs from Ollama's local preflight rule.

review_method: Independent SciPy object readback, Decimal arithmetic, parsed trace rows, literal quotation/applicability verification and direct claim/task/recommendation review. Labels are not a blind owner assessment; full-case scores are provisional.

security.interpretation: Four live model attacks (three reused, one new), seven forced HTTP-response boundary checks and one no-model Markdown rendering check. S01 required code-enforced rejection and did not complete its investigation.

timing.scope: Individual CLI wall times include startup/report writing; graph times exclude them. Two reused timings are from prior collection dates. No latency-distribution or repeatability claim.

conservative_planning_scenario.limitation: An input-size assumption, not a guaranteed upper cost bound.

pricing.scope: New token spending only; existing observations are not billed again. Actual provider usage, billing currency conversion, tax, credits and account charges can differ. No API requests were made to obtain this estimate.

spending.note: The intentional D22 HTTP-404 response returned no usage and is excluded from the known-cost subtotal. Unknown usage is not asserted to be free. Actual billing, tax and currency conversion were not inspected.

remaining_work: Fix the material citation/restart and recommendation failures in a separate candidate, then verify changes with targeted checks before the controlled demo. Preserve this first acceptance pass unchanged.
